title: Exploring ecosystem structure and function of the northern Kerguelen Plateau using a mass-balanced food web model
authors: Roshni C. Subramaniam; Stuart P. Corney; Kerrie M. Swadling; Jessica Melbourne-Thomas
model_years: Multiyear mean; extended to late 1980s–2018 in companion description
loadability_evidence: No native EwE model file was verified or loaded; paper availability does not establish complete reconstruction.
documentation_evidence: Primary publisher text explicitly extends the French-EEZ model to Heard and McDonald Islands; model domain is 60–80°E, 45–56°S. Companion open paper provides baseline tables.
notes: Regional model including French and Australian fishing zones; no EEZ-specific partition. Download alternative is the author's 2021 thesis Subramaniam_whole_thesis.pdf; repository rights statement identifies chapter 3 as equivalent to a post-print of this article. This is a thesis container, not the publisher PDF. Normal GET response verified 200 application/pdf (24,106,909 bytes), without downloading body. HEAD returned 403 on the signed redirect.
quality_rationale: Provisional screening score. A readable source is not evidence of a successfully reconstructed or load-tested Ecopath model. No native EwE model file was verified or loaded; paper availability does not establish complete reconstruction.
geometry_method: Approximate reported study bounds; not an author-supplied polygon
geometry_note: Author-reported rectangular model domain (Figure 1 and model-domain text); genuine domain envelope, not EEZ-specific coverage.
recommendation: Northern Kerguelen Plateau model contains Heard/McDonald and French Kerguelen waters; aggregate regional food web.
coverage_note: Northern Kerguelen Plateau model contains Heard/McDonald and French Kerguelen waters; aggregate regional food web.
